subject: Approval request — replace IC3 SWE and uplift for internal transfer
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request — replace IC3 SWE and uplift for internal transfer

Hi Laura / Markus,

Quick context: Maya's IC3 SWE (team: Edge Serving) resigned last week and her last day is 2/20. We have an internal candidate, Rohan Mehta (currently SWE IC3 on Platform), who has expressed interest in moving to Edge and taking over the role. Rohan is a strong contributor and the hiring manager (me) is proposing to bring him in at IC4 to reflect the broader scope and ownership required for the position.

Why uplift to IC4?
- The role now includes cross-team ownership for KV cache improvements and an extra 20% on-call scope.
- Rohan has successfully driven two infra initiatives and has positive calibration with other IC4s on the team.

Request:
1) Headcount: immediate replacement for Maya (1 FTE).
2) Level: approve internal transfer + relevel to IC4 (title: SWE IV).
3) Comp: propose a base range of $195k–$215k for hire band (Rohan current base: $170k). Total comp uplift to be finalized with People Ops.

Attachments: Rohan CV and proposed_comp_table.csv (draft comp math + compa ratio scenarios).

Because this is an internal move, I want a quick greenlight from Finance and People Ops this week so we can make an offer before Maya's last day. If you want a different cadence (hire at IC3 then uplift after 6 months) say so — I prefer to avoid rehiring externally for the same work.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Engineering Manager, Edge Serving
Redwood Inference
(attachment: rohan_cv.pdf, PDF)
(attachment: proposed_comp_table.csv, CSV)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request — replace IC3 SWE and uplift for internal transfer

Thanks for the context — and for the attachments. A few quick questions before I loop Finance:

1) Do you have compbench reference for the IC4 comp band in your market (SF Bay)? If not, happy to pull compbench (cc'ing benchmarks).
2) What is the business impact if we keep the role at IC3 and do a promotion/uplift after 6 months? I want the JML (jump-in & measurable lead) expectations documented so Finance can evaluate ROI.
3) Confirm that Rohan is open to the final comp range you proposed and understands potential reduction in stock refresh cadence if we move him now.

If you can respond to those with short bullets I'll route to Finance and People Ops.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Stephanie / Laura — thanks for the writeup. High level: I support filling the headcount and keeping it internal where possible. A couple of thoughts from Finance:

- Approve in principle the IC4 uplift if you can demonstrate 1) clear added responsibilities and 2) measurable deliverables in 6 months (OKR-linked).
- Alternative that reduces short-term spend: hire Rohan at IC3 with a written re-evaluation at 6 months tied to specific deliverables and a pre-authorized uplift if metrics are met. That keeps comp spending conservative now.
- Please provide compbench export (regional), and the comp_summary_q1_2026.xlsx attached here has the projected run-rate impact on FY26 payroll depending on the scenario.

If you prefer the direct IC4 path, I need signoff from CFO for the incremental run-rate. If you prefer the staged path, I can approve the headcount and earmark funds for the 6-month uplift contingent on OKRs.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final signoff: Rohan internal transfer + comp recommendation

Hi all — looping back after People Ops calibration. Summary and final recommendation below.

Decision summary:
- Headcount: APPROVED to replace Maya (1 FTE).
- Level: APPROVED for internal transfer and relevel to SWE IV (IC4).
- Comp recommendation: Base $200,000 + target equity refresh of 0.6% (refresh schedule to be standard for IC4 tenure). Total target comp aligns to $220k–$240k on on-target calculations (base + refresh).
- Condition: Rohan to sign a 6-month onboarding/OKR plan (we'll attach the plan to the offer). If OKRs not met, the hire will be reviewed by People Ops and the hiring manager.

Next steps:
1) Stephanie: confirm with Rohan that he accepts the proposed base and the OKR condition.
2) People Ops (Neha) to prepare the internal offer packet and equity paperwork.
3) Finance (Markus) to route final run-rate signoff; Markus — please confirm if you want to approve now or after the offer accepted.

Attachments: offer_packet_v2.pdf (internal offer template + equity math).

Neha Kapoor
Senior People Partner, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
(attachment: offer_packet_v2.pdf, PDF)
